data.title: Dimensions
data.subtitle: ChaosD6 open-rules RPG
data.premise: A tile-and-card RPG where every character is a four-pillar being traveling between bounded Dimensions. Each Dimension is a tileset of hidden traps, awakening creatures, class cards, towers and crystals that must be unraveled...
data.species_sum_rule: Playable races have Σ(stats) = 40. Ordinary objects: 0 Vitality & 0 Will. Plants: 0 Will. Astral/undead: 0 Vitality. Magical/ethereal: non-zero World.
data.progression_model: Lateral — no levels. Character value = count of non-action cards in deck. Long-term endgame = puzzle buildings assembled from parts (8.6).

win_conditions.mmorpg: no single global win; alliance territory, dimension control, puzzle completions

data.death_rule: Return to tower (regenerate) OR replace character if no tower chosen.
data.tone: fantasy / elemental / dimensional / player-driven rules evolution

p2p_extension.transport_metaphor: magnet-uri style DoorId pointing to the active hashgraph head

sync_tiers.scope: all clans + unmet players; a random active player commits the merged DoorId.json

p2p_extension.fog_of_war: Clans that haven't met have divergent map state; divergence is reconciled at first meeting (hashgraph merge) and periodically via radicle push.
p2p_extension.voting_model: Rebalance proposals land as proposals/<entry_id>-<ts>; votes signed by peer_id; weight accrues; rebalance_script may counter-propose linked deltas; on merge, the next session load picks up the new canonical version.

logic.description: The core concept of Dimensions: every unit is a four-pillar being with stats Vitality (physical), World (spiritual), Matter (emotional) and Will (mental); the pillars are exactly the four stats entries (stat_vitality, stat_world, stat_matter, stat_will) and every element maps to one of them. Species rule: playable races have sum(stats) = 40 (hence 4 life by Rule 14: life = round_half_up(sum / 10)); ordinary objects have 0 Vitality and 0 Will, plants 0 Will, astral/undead 0 Vitality, magical/ethereal beings non-zero World. A Dimension is a tileset of 3x4, 4x4, 5x5 or 8x8 tiles holding face-down trap effects, monsters, class cards, towers, crystals, libraries, nexus, doors, mines and stashes; it is entered by nexus drop, dimension door or a new-game library spawn. Progression is lateral (no levels; character value = non-action cards in the deck); win conditions: arena = defeat opponents, world = control 12 monsters, mmorpg = no single global win. Death returns the character to its tower or replaces it.

prerequisites.description: Every pillar named in the concept has a stats entry stat_<pillar> in the catalog.

effects.description: The stat sum every playable race must have.
True when the unit's stats obey the species sum rule (characters only; creatures vary).
Life of a unit from its pillars (Rule 14): 40 -> 4.
A unit has exactly four pillars.
The tileset sides a Dimension may have.
World mode: monsters to control to win.

validation.description: species_sum_rule stays a string and still states the playable sum of 40.
pillars stays an array of the same four stat names (both directions subset).
pillar_metaphor is an object whose values are pillars.
world_structure.tileset_sizes stays a non-empty list that still contains the 3x4 base size.
